# Yahoo News

> Yahoo News is a comprehensive breaking news and information platform covering politics, world events, US news, science, health, and entertainment with original reporting and live updates.

Yahoo News aggregates and produces original coverage across major news categories including political developments, international affairs, health and science breakthroughs, and entertainment. The site offers newsletters, trending stories, and fact-checked reporting on critical topics like the pandemic, climate change, and military conflicts.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- Politics
- World News
- US News
- Iran
- Trump Administration
- Science & Space
- Health & Vaccines
- Climate Change
- Entertainment
- Military & Security
- Coronavirus
- Crime & Law Enforcement
- Original Coverage
- News Aggregation

## Core News Sections

- [Yahoo News: Latest and Breaking News, Headlines, Live Updates, and More](https://news.yahoo.com): Yahoo News homepage with breaking news, top stories, and live updates across all topics
- [US | Yahoo News - Latest News & Headlines](https://news.yahoo.com/us): US news section with breaking stories, local news, and crime updates
- [Latest Political News, Updates, and Analysis - Yahoo News](https://news.yahoo.com/politics): Political news coverage including elections, Trump administration, and congressional updates
- [World News - Latest and Breaking Coverage - Yahoo News](https://news.yahoo.com/world): International news coverage including Iran, Germany, and global breaking stories

## Science, Health & Environment

- [Latest Science News and Updates on Space, Climate Change and More - Yahoo News](https://news.yahoo.com/science): Science news including space, NASA missions, astronomy, and earth science discoveries
- [Yahoo News: Latest and Breaking News, Headlines, Live Updates, and More](https://news.yahoo.com/health): Health news covering medical breakthroughs, vaccines, wellness, and maternal health
- [Yahoo News: Latest and Breaking News, Headlines, Live Updates, and More](https://news.yahoo.com/tagged/climate-change): Climate change news covering weather disasters, flooding, drought, and environmental impacts
- [Coronavirus | Yahoo – Latest News & Headlines](https://news.yahoo.com/coronavirus): COVID-19 news, vaccine research, and pandemic coverage with fact-checking
